review_scope: Read-only review of the current same-handle snapshot fix, regression tests, and supplied diagnostic receipt. No tests, runner, Docker commands, API calls, or edits were performed by this reviewer.

previous_review_finding.finding: Path-based open could follow a raced symlink between link checks and the read.
previous_review_finding.closure: Windows opens with CreateFileW OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and denies concurrent write/delete sharing, rejects reparse/directory/multilink handles, checks GetFinalPathNameByHandle against the approved canonical path before reading, then reads through the same handle. POSIX walks each parent using dir_fd + O_DIRECTORY + O_NOFOLLOW and opens the final component with O_NOFOLLOW, then validates fstat identity/type/size before and after reading the same descriptor.

regression_test_review.method: The tests deterministically substitute a link immediately before the real same-handle open, then assert ContractError rather than return of the outside sentinel bytes.
regression_test_review.adequacy: These exercise the precise prior TOCTOU boundary. Windows' handle final-path and reparse checks reject before reading; POSIX anchored no-follow traversal refuses the swapped component. Owner reports the old implementation RED and the final focused suite GREEN; those commands were not independently rerun here.

conditional_hardening.finding: The runner still requires the three pytest variables but permits other image-baked Env entries. Host environment is scrubbed and the isolated Docker config is explicit; this is not host-env inheritance. Continue to require trusted image provenance and no credentials baked into the selected image, or tighten the image Env allowlist if that is part of the operational guarantee.

verified_source_controls: The same descriptor is used for pre-read fstat, bounded read, and post-read fstat.
Windows denies concurrent write/delete sharing while the handle is open and checks the resolved handle path before reading.
POSIX openat-style directory traversal is anchored to the resolved workspace and refuses unsupported hosts rather than falling back to ordinary open.
Existing hard-link, regular-file, per-file, total snapshot size, path allowlist, and content-hash checks remain in place.
Previously reviewed Docker limits, read-only single bind mount, timeout/output bounds, and forced cleanup remain unchanged in the inspected source.
known_limitations: Docker daemon, image provenance, and host kernel remain trusted infrastructure; container controls are defense in depth.
A malicious pinned test suite can spoof textual pytest summaries; the runner cannot prove arbitrary Python test honesty.
Owner-reported 23 tests and live hostile Docker probes are evidence supplied for review, not independently repeated in this rereview.
